$comment: Labels and descriptions for every fixed value in problem.schema.json: statuses, fields, AI effort levels, ratings, checkpoint statuses, contributor kinds and source kinds. The validator checks that the two files list the same values and that every value has a label and a description, so update both together. Shared by the site, and later the extension and app.

open.label: Open
open.description: Not settled, and open-ended: there is no single agreed statement of what "solved" means yet, so progress is measured in milestones (for example a technology goal, or a phenomenon whose explanation has not been narrowed to one precise question yet).

unsolved.label: Unsolved
unsolved.description: Precisely stated, with a definite answer that nobody has found yet (for example a conjecture with no accepted proof or disproof).

solved.label: Solved
solved.description: Answered as posed: a proof, disproof, construction, algorithm or measurement has been found and accepted.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.description: Closed without an answer as posed: shown impossible, independent of the usual axioms, ill-posed, or superseded by later understanding.

mathematics.label: Mathematics
mathematics.description: Pure and applied mathematics, including logic and statistics.

computer-science.label: Computer science
computer-science.description: Computing in theory and practice: algorithms, complexity, programming, AI and systems.

physics.label: Physics
physics.description: Matter, energy and forces, from particles to materials and fluids.

astronomy.label: Astronomy
astronomy.description: Planets, stars, galaxies and the universe as a whole.

chemistry.label: Chemistry
chemistry.description: Substances, how they are built and how they react.

biology.label: Biology
biology.description: Living things, from molecules and cells to ecosystems and evolution.

medicine.label: Medicine
medicine.description: Human health and disease: causes, diagnosis, treatment and prevention.

earth-science.label: Earth science
earth-science.description: The Earth's rocks, oceans, atmosphere and climate.

engineering.label: Engineering
engineering.description: Designing and building structures, machines, devices, materials and processes.

low.label: Low
low.description: A quick AI session is enough: summarizing known results, checking sources or tidying the progress map.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Standard reasoning: working through known arguments, reproducing a calculation or drafting a checkpoint write-up.

high.label: High
high.description: Extended reasoning: long derivations, careful proof or code checking, and comparing many sources.

max.label: Max
max.description: Frontier work: the deepest reasoning settings, long multi-agent research runs, and expert human review of every claim.

work_left.label: Work left
work_left.description: How much work is left before the problem is fully solved.

significance.label: Significance
significance.description: Real-world significance if the problem is fully solved.
significance.high: Would change everyday life or technology

done.label: Done
done.description: Reached and accepted. Build on it instead of redoing it.

in-progress.label: In progress
in-progress.description: Someone is working on this now. Check with them before starting the same work.

not-started.label: Not started
not-started.description: A known next step that nobody has taken yet.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Claimed, but not yet accepted, or contested by others.

dead-end.label: Dead end
dead-end.description: Tried and did not work. Recorded so nobody repeats it without a new idea.

group.label: Group
group.description: A team, lab, collaboration or project credited as a whole.

ai.label: AI
ai.description: An AI system or agent. Credit AI work openly, next to the people who directed or checked it.

paper.label: Paper
paper.description: A paper in a journal or conference proceedings.

preprint.label: Preprint
preprint.description: A paper shared before, or without, peer review.

book.label: Book
book.description: A book, or a chapter of one.

article.label: Article
article.description: A news, magazine or encyclopedia article, or a blog post.

website.label: Website
website.description: A web page or site, such as a project page.

video.label: Video
video.description: A recorded talk, lecture or other video.
